verdicts.reason: In frame f0000697, the right hand is clearly visible resting on the handle of a screwdriver with a black and green grip lying on the white tabletop.

Comparing frame f0000697 where the screwdriver is flat on the table, to frame f0000706 where the right hand is holding the screwdriver in a raised, vertical position, confirms the transition described.
Frames f0000715 and f0000725 show the left hand holding a silver metallic object (likely a starter motor) with visible circular openings on its face.

In frame f0000734, the right hand holds the screwdriver shaft angled toward the silver component held in the left hand. By frame f0000743, the shaft has shifted to a more horizontal position beside the component. The tip remains outside the component in both frames, confirming no completed insertion occurred within this span.
